Read More Shares of Amtech Systems trade on the Nasdaq under the ticker ASYS. © Copyright 2012 - 2026 | citybiz | Terms of Service | All Rights Reserved Amtech Systems has appointed semiconductor industry veteran Guy Shechter as president and chief operating officer, creating a new executive leadership role as the company expands its focus on AI semiconductor packaging and advanced substrate manufacturing. The Tempe, Ariz.-based equipment manufacturer said Shechter will officially join the company May 19 and report directly to CEO Bob Daigle. His appointment signals a continued operational buildout at Amtech as semiconductor equipment suppliers compete for market share in packaging technologies increasingly viewed as critical to AI chip performance. Daigle said Shechter’s background in semiconductor equipment and advanced packaging operations aligns with Amtech’s effort to broaden its product portfolio and scale growth initiatives.

hits.snippet: **Fort Washington, PA – August 5, 2025** – [Amtech Software,](https://www.amtechsoftware.com/) a leading provider of ERP and manufacturing execution software for the packaging industry, today announced the appointment of Billy Medof to its Board of Directors. Medof brings more than two decades of leadership experience in packaging, procurement, and operations. He currently serves as an Operating Partner at Altamont Capital Partners, focused on supporting investments in the packaging sector. “Billy brings a rare combination of hands-on industry knowledge, commercial insight, and leadership experience,” said Chuck Schneider, CEO of Amtech Software. “His experience speaks for itself, and we’re excited to have his voice at the table as we continue building the next generation of software for the packaging industry.” Medof previously served as CEO of Procure Analytics, a group purchasing organization serving over 1,000 member companies, and as President of Georgia-Pacific Corrugated, where he also led the company’s national Sheet Feeder business.
